verdict.line: You win if you convert your early lane and solo-kill edge into a fast R (All Out) kill before level 9; you lose if Teemo's Q blind and ranged poison drag the lane into a long neutral stalemate, which is why the matchup still sits at 44.5% over 875 games.

brief.thesis: K'Sante holds the measured lane and solo-kill advantage into Teemo because R (All Out) launches Teemo through walls and strips his only real defense, mobility. But the overall win rate is still only 44.5% over 875 games, because Teemo's Q (Blinding Dart) blind and E (Toxic Shot) poison let him survive the early window and chip you down from range instead of trading in melee. The matchup is decided by tempo: whoever controls whether the lane resolves fast or drags long wins it.

theirWindow.what: He'll blind your auto-attack on first contact, cutting off the follow-up hit that benefits from your Dauntless Instinct mark, then kite off with W (Move Quick)'s passive speed. Don't commit E (Footwork) into him here, you'll eat free poison autos for no return damage.

yourWindow.when: his Q (Blinding Dart) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: This is your real engage window. Dash in with E (Footwork), land Q (Ntofo Strikes) to build stacks or trigger the 2-stack shockwave pull, and from level 6 use R (All Out) to knock him through the nearest wall before he can reset distance.

start.why: Measured at 44.7% over 640 games and the majority pick at 58.9%. The sustain and magic resist blunt Teemo's Q damage and the early Toxic Shot poison ticks that otherwise chip you down for free while he stays out of melee range.

boots.why: 44.8% over 683 games and 66.4% pick. Magic resist and tenacity directly counter Toxic Shot's poison and the slow from R (Noxious Trap), which are the two tools Teemo uses to keep you out of E (Footwork) dash range.

core.why: Magic resist and a spell shield absorb a full burst of ranged poke, letting you close the gap on Teemo without losing the trade purely to chip damage.
CDR and an on-hit slow wave help you actually stick to a kiting target once you've committed E (Footwork) or R (All Out).
Best measured finisher on this path at 55.7% over 106 games, 17.6% pick. Stacking resistances scale your R (All Out)'s reduced-defense window into something survivable.

situational.when: the Teemo's poison and trap uptime is outlasting your sustain through a long neutral lane
the enemy team adds a crit or attack-speed carry that punishes your reduced defenses during All Out
you're grouping fights around your own carry and want to convert All Out's damage window into a team fight tool

runes.keystoneWhy: Your CC, the W (Path Maker) stun and the R (All Out) knockback, triggers Aftershock's resistance burst right as you commit, covering the exact window where All Out strips your own defenses. Master-tier K'Sante players instead run Grasp of the Undying across 14,279 games; it suits players who plan to win this lane by out-sustaining Teemo's poke over a long trade rather than burst-killing him with R.

summoners.why: Flash + Teleport is the standard pick at 76.8% but only 42.7% win rate. Flash + Ignite is run far less (15% pick) yet measures 54.4%, and it matches your solo-kill advantage directly, Ignite's grievous wounds shuts down Teemo's main defensive tool, kiting back to heal off poison ticks, during your R (All Out) window.

playing.title: Hold E until his Q is down
playing.detail: Don't dash in with E (Footwork) while Teemo's Q (Blinding Dart) is up; you'll lose the auto-attack that benefits from your passive mark. Engage only once you've seen him spend it.

playing.title: Use R to erase his escape
playing.detail: R (All Out)'s knockback launches him through any wall in his path, which deletes the kiting space W (Move Quick) and his range normally buy him. This is your single biggest edge, use it to start fights, not finish them.

playing.title: Farm Q stacks before committing
playing.detail: Q (Ntofo Strikes) grants a stack on hit and fires a pulling shockwave at 2 stacks. Landing two pokes before you dash in turns his kiting space into a guaranteed stick.

playing.title: Don't facecheck for traps
playing.detail: R (Noxious Trap) has only a 1s cooldown and Teemo can camouflage in brush after standing still, so an idle bush near his wave can be a stacked minefield. Ward or Q it before walking through.

playing.title: Build magic resist on curve
playing.detail: Doran's Helm into Mercury's Treads into Kaenic Rookern is a straight line of magic resist against a purely magic-damage poke lane. Skipping any of it lets Toxic Shot and trap damage snowball the lane for him.

playing.title: Don't let the game go long
playing.detail: The 44.5% win rate over 875 games reflects what happens when this lane drags: Teemo scales into permanent kiting and trap-zoned sieges. Press your level 6-8 kill windows rather than playing for a slow scaling game.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and all win-rate figures above are measured from live games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning and trade-window calls are my own read of the matchup, not sourced from the data.
